minimal.description: Calm and premium: off-white, one accent bar, lots of air. The safe default for experts and services.

bold.description: Loud and punchy: huge uppercase headlines, accent cover and CTA, marker highlights. For hot takes and lists.

editorial.description: Magazine feel: serif display type, rules and issue-style headers. For essays, stories and opinion.

tweet.description: Each slide reads like a text post card with avatar and handle. For founders and personal brands.

data.description: Dark grid, big numbers, mono labels. For stats, research, case-study results.

steps.description: Progress rail and big step numbers. For how-tos, checklists and processes.
